turns.user_input: I got a court notice yesterday about a case my landlord filed against me. It says I must reply by next week. What should I do?

response.reply:
You need to consult a qualified advocate soon to handle this matter properly. 

To help brief the advocate, could you check:
1. What is the exact title of the document and which court or authority issued it?
2. What are the specific dates printed on the notice?

Please speak to a qualified advocate as soon as possible, ideally before the date on the document. This tool cannot tell you any deadline, because deadlines depend on the exact document and court. If you cannot afford a lawyer, contact your District Legal Services Authority (see nalsa.gov.in) for free legal aid. Do not ignore the document. Keep the original and any envelope or proof of the date you received it.
